claim: Direction B design packet is complete as a written, redacted, parcel-first interface contract with one generated visual reference.

included: route map, task flow, panel hierarchy, and replay behavior
coverage truth for Miami-Dade private beta, municipality-conditional Broward/Palm Beach, and planned/not-enabled San Diego
zoning, setbacks, constraints, survey/plat, capacity/max-units, comps, purchase-ceiling, evidence/replay, and grounded-LLM abstention contracts
accessibility, overflow, focus, and reduced-motion self-audit
single built-in ImageGen visual reference with prompt/output/fixture hash binding
excluded: live source retrieval or legal/engineering/valuation validation
live browser visual QA, which applies only after a UI implementation exists

success_criteria_evidence.scenario: Open the documentation packet and trace parcel selection through source-backed feasibility abstention.
success_criteria_evidence.binary_observable: All required concepts are present in the owned packet and capacity/ceiling abstention is explicitly specified.

success_criteria_evidence.scenario: Parse the deterministic redacted fixture and verify incomplete inputs do not become numeric conclusions.
success_criteria_evidence.invocation: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('artifacts/design/direction-b/fixture-direction-b-v1.json','utf8')); if(d.capacity.result!==null||d.underwriting.purchase_ceiling!==null||d.capacity.status!=='needs_verification') process.exit(2); console.log('fixture JSON valid; abstention invariants hold')"
success_criteria_evidence.binary_observable: exit 0 and exact output: fixture JSON valid; abstention invariants hold

success_criteria_evidence.scenario: Verify the sole image reference is copied, a valid PNG, and hash-bound to its versioned prompt.
success_criteria_evidence.binary_observable: PNG signature reports 1586 x 992 RGB and SHA-256 values match imagegen.metadata.json/checksums.sha256.

success_criteria_evidence.scenario: Review responsive, accessibility, overflow, focus, and reduced-motion acceptance criteria.
success_criteria_evidence.binary_observable: All three specified viewports and audit checks are documented; no runtime UI is falsely claimed tested.

manual_document_qa.limitation: This is a design-only artifact; browser visual QA is intentionally deferred until implementation.
